question: U10 family rule, its own round (lead, 2026-11-07): the step from tile to tile in a 5 tile list sorts types into families. Code family: Code, Quote, Accordion, Markdown, Audio, Embed, Tag Cloud. Instagram family: Instagram, Flickr, Chart, Calendar. Others: Bandsintown, Tock, SoundCloud; Menu. Predictions, pushed and frozen before any read. Two picks per type, Blocks Probe, unsaved, one type per reload.
basis: Code family from CAP-U10PICK-CODE (places, rows past the block, look). Flickr from CAP-U10SHARE-INSTAGRAM, the same picks.

as Code's pick 2: desktop row start 3, columns 3/13; phone row start 2, columns 2/10; section rows = desktop end row - 1 + 4; look: dark, rounded divider. Height is the block's own, not predicted
